default: Travellers, keep to the marked way.
Whoever reads this has come far. Rest if you must, but do not linger.
Property of those who still keep watch here. Touch nothing you cannot carry.
The way back is the way you came. Remember it.
Lights out at dusk. The {setting} is not kind to the careless.
hall: All who pass through this hall pay respect to the dust of ages.
Speak softly in the hall; the walls remember.
chamber: This chamber is closed to visitors. Knock twice, then leave.
Whatever sleeps in this chamber was left that way on purpose.
corridor: The corridor bends twice. The second bend is the dangerous one.
courtyard: Gather in the courtyard at first bell.
Water is shared here. Draw only what you need.
cave: The air thins further in. Carry a light.
Marks on the stone show where others turned back.
outdoor: Fair weather holds only until the road bends.
Fork ahead: the lesser path is the shorter one.
street: Quiet hours begin at the last bell.
Merchants to the left, mourners to the right.
deck: Hold fast when the swell rises.
Cargo below. Passengers stay clear of the hatch.
vault: What is kept here was kept for a reason.
Keys are counted at every change of the watch.
garden: Please stay on the paths; the beds are tended.
Whatever grows here, grows with care.
shore: The tide comes in faster than you think.
Nothing washed ashore here is free to keep.

chest.locked: A chest, shut tight and locked.
chest.closed: A chest, closed but not locked.

sign.any: A sign with writing on it.

pile.empty: A bare patch where items were dropped.
